disturbance_disclosure: This is a MUD-TEMPERATURE log, NOT an equilibrium profile: per the in-file header, circulation stopped 09:00 01/01/94 and the logger was at bottom 07:45 02/01/94 (~22.75 h shut-in). Per the GFZ data report (STR 21/03), all KTB single temperature logs reflect the temporary, drilling-disturbed temperature field; the best equilibrium approximation is the 1996-2000 log set (ZIP-bound, not text-accessible). The values here are real measurements of what the sonde read - carried as such, not as formation equilibrium temperature.
format_disclosure: Transcribed from the legacy site's HTML rendering of the ASCII log; the '!'-prefixed header lines and space-separated data rows are preserved as rendered (the HTML wrapper markup is not part of the record).
purpose: twelfth catalogue entry - the catalogue's first HOT temperature data (both prior measured T-curves are ice boreholes): 170-185 degC crystalline rock at 7.7-8.0 km, HPHT-simulator-relevant regime; NINTH region (Germany); first KTB/.dat dialect (read_ktb_dat)
